label: FREE GUIDE
headline: Make your emails work harder, simply.
body: This free guide offers 21 short, practical email marketing tactics you can apply to your business, one step at a time.
caption: Email marketing doesn't have to be complicated or time-consuming. We put together '21 Email Marketing Hacks' with you in mind. This free guide is packed with simple, practical ideas you can try one at a time, fitting into your busy schedule. No jargon, just clear steps to help you connect with your audience. Ready to find a few new tricks? Grab your copy now.
